tasks.title: Create autonomous execution system inside the repo
tasks.notes: Foundational control plane for autonomous work.

tasks.title: Make verification and trust wording machine-checkable
tasks.notes: Completed with release-gate integration and passing tests.

tasks.title: Centralize high-risk product trust copy into one source of truth
tasks.notes: Completed via frontend/app/lib/trust-copy.ts and usage checks.

tasks.title: Reduce dashboard orchestration complexity by feature-domain decomposition
tasks.notes: Completed. Controller/bootstrap/view-model entrypoints are composition-only, runtime responsibilities are split into domain hooks, and decomposition boundaries are guarded by tests.

tasks.title: Reduce frontend snapshot transfer cost
tasks.notes: Completed. Main payload no longer ships per-place measurements or sample history; lazy details/history assets and frontend loaders were added and validated.

tasks.title: Version production data and ML contracts
tasks.notes: Completed. Machine-readable contract, validator, release-gate integration, and offline-safe frontend build path are in place.

tasks.title: Complete backend verification path for published snapshots
tasks.notes: Completed in repo scope. Backend signing now prefers the official Aletheia evidence package download, the frontend verifier supports cryptographic verification of official bundles and integrity-only verification of legacy bundles, and release/docs/trust guards were updated for the transition window.

tasks.title: Align status docs and operator-facing notes with the current project state
tasks.notes: Completed. Residual status drift between phase docs and current operator notes was reduced and the follow-up queue was extended beyond the original roadmap.

tasks.title: Unify verify and trust surfaces with the main product shell
tasks.notes: Completed. `/verify` now uses a server-page wrapper with metadata, a client subcomponent, and shared product styling instead of isolated inline-only presentation.

tasks.title: Tighten app-shell consistency for metadata, trust entrypoints, and user guidance
tasks.notes: Completed for the current routing model. Metadata constants were centralized, `/verify` and root shell now share the same site-metadata source, the root footer disclaimer is language-aware, and `html lang` is aligned to the saved UI language before hydration. Full per-locale route SEO remains out of scope until the app adopts route-level localization.

tasks.title: Activate telemetry as an operational loop instead of dormant instrumentation
tasks.notes: Completed end-to-end. The analytics worker is deployed at analytics.h2oatlas.ee with KV-backed counters, the Pages production and preview environments point to the live endpoint, smoke tests pass, and the remaining work is organizational cadence rather than technical activation.

tasks.title: Package the product for external stakeholders and partnership conversations
tasks.notes: Completed. A partnership package now exists with a one-page narrative, stakeholder matrix, trust posture rules, and deck inputs for municipalities, NGOs, Terviseamet, academic, and civic-tech conversations.

tasks.title: Turn live telemetry counters into a reproducible operator review flow
tasks.notes: Completed. Operators can now pull a 7-day analytics summary directly from the live Cloudflare KV namespace with a single repo script instead of manually querying counters in the dashboard.

tasks.title: Turn analytics review output into decision-ready findings and recommended actions
tasks.notes: Completed. The analytics review helper now interprets KPI ranges, flags weak funnels, and emits a markdown-ready weekly review with findings and recommended product actions.

tasks.title: Make the release gate fail with actionable setup diagnostics instead of opaque environment errors
tasks.notes: Completed. The release gate now checks core Python/frontend prerequisites up front and fails with explicit install guidance instead of surfacing setup drift as a later-stage validation failure.

tasks.title: Create one canonical program-status view that separates repo completion from operational readiness
tasks.notes: Completed. `docs/PROGRAM_STATUS.md` now states what is repo-ready, live-ready, and org-ready so status claims stay legible as the product transitions from project to service.

tasks.title: Publish the next autonomous execution plan as an operating document inside the repo
tasks.notes: Completed. `docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md` captures the current autonomous priority order so future work can optimize for baseline hardening before expansion.

tasks.title: Restore local frontend validation parity so lint, typecheck, and build can run in the same autonomous environment
tasks.notes: Completed. A local Node toolchain was found under `~/.nvm`, the full release gate now passes end-to-end including frontend lint/typecheck/build, and `verify_release.sh` was updated to search common local `.nvm` and project `.tools` Node installations automatically.

tasks.title: Make operational ownership and access boundaries explicit so the product can outgrow single-maintainer memory
tasks.notes: Completed. `docs/OWNERSHIP_AND_ACCESS.md` now captures ownership domains, access boundaries, concentration risks, and the two-person resilience target, with tests guarding the key doc links.

tasks.title: Reduce `build_citizen_snapshot.py` orchestration complexity by extracting publishable helper boundaries
tasks.notes: Completed. The citizen snapshot builder now has explicit helpers for latest/history preparation, per-place record construction, and snapshot-envelope assembly, with targeted tests guarding dedupe/history/provenance behavior.

tasks.title: Reduce duplicated opendata parser mechanics in `src/data_loader.py` without changing XML parsing semantics
tasks.notes: Completed. The opendata parsers now share common record-bootstrap and frame-finalization helpers, reducing duplication across supluskoha/veevark/basseinid/joogivesi/mineraalvesi while preserving parser behavior under tests and the full release gate.

tasks.title: Extract per-place geocoding and county-resolution orchestration from `build_citizen_snapshot.py`
tasks.notes: Completed. The snapshot builder now routes one-place coordinate and county resolution through explicit helpers, with tests covering manual overrides, hidden rows, and county inference behavior under the release gate.

tasks.title: Extract model-training and bundle-persistence orchestration from `build_citizen_snapshot.py`
tasks.notes: Completed. The snapshot builder now routes probability attachment and bundle persistence through explicit helpers, with targeted tests for the bundle contract and a more robust LightGBM fallback path when the Python package is present but its native runtime dependency is missing.

tasks.title: Extract snapshot row-loop orchestration and cache-persistence flow from `build_citizen_snapshot.py`
tasks.notes: Completed. The per-place row loop and coordinate-cache persistence now live behind explicit helpers, tests cover visible/hidden/overridden row accumulation, and the snapshot envelope now derives LightGBM availability from the persisted model bundle instead of a leaked local variable.

tasks.title: Extract derived/filter/analytics composition from `use-dashboard-controller-runtime.ts`
tasks.notes: Completed. The dashboard runtime now delegates derived data, filter runtime, and analytics runtime composition to `use-dashboard-controller-collections-runtime.ts`, reducing orchestration density in `use-dashboard-controller-runtime.ts` while preserving the release baseline.

tasks.title: Extract trust/actions/history-measurement composition from `use-dashboard-controller-runtime.ts`
tasks.notes: Completed. The dashboard runtime now delegates trust, actions, and history-measurement composition to `use-dashboard-controller-interaction-runtime.ts`, leaving `use-dashboard-controller-runtime.ts` closer to a scene-level composition root.

tasks.title: Split `dashboard-content.ts` into bounded content modules while preserving the facade import surface
tasks.notes: Completed. `dashboard-content.ts` is now a thin facade that re-exports expert-mode copy, parameter content, and shared content types from dedicated modules, while existing consumers continue importing through the stable facade surface.

tasks.title: Split `use-dashboard-trust.ts` into copy, explainers, and freshness subdomains
tasks.notes: Completed. `use-dashboard-trust.ts` now acts as a composition entrypoint over dedicated copy, explainer, and freshness hooks, reducing responsibility density without changing the downstream runtime contract.

tasks.title: Split `use-dashboard-map-environment.ts` into responsive, county-geo, and header-scroll subhooks
tasks.notes: Completed. The map environment hook now composes dedicated responsive/viewport, county-geo enrichment, and header-scroll effects instead of keeping these unrelated responsibilities in one scene-state helper.

tasks.title: Split `use-dashboard-actions.ts` into preference and map/filter action domains
tasks.notes: Completed. `use-dashboard-actions.ts` now acts as a composition layer over preference-oriented actions and map/filter/mobile selection actions, reducing mixed responsibility density while preserving the runtime surface.

tasks.title: Split `use-dashboard-view-actions.ts` into info-page, preference, and filter/theme action domains
tasks.notes: Completed. `use-dashboard-view-actions.ts` now composes dedicated info-page navigation, preference/sidebar actions, and geo/date/theme actions instead of mixing those concerns in one hook.

tasks.title: Split `dashboard-translations.ts` into language modules and shared translation types
tasks.notes: Completed. The dashboard translation surface still exports `DASHBOARD_TRANSLATIONS`, but the copy now lives in dedicated per-language modules with shared typing instead of one large content monolith.

tasks.title: Tighten shell metadata semantics and refresh the product audit against the real release baseline
deliverables: conservative root Open Graph locale posture
tasks.notes: Completed. Shared site-route helpers now reduce metadata drift across layout, sitemap, robots, OG, and `/verify`; the root layout no longer emits Open Graph locale alternates for a single multilingual URL; and the audit/status/plan docs now distinguish verified baseline from remaining productization work after a passing end-to-end release gate.

tasks.title: Make freshness and staleness thresholds explicit across UI, release docs, and live smoke
tasks.notes: Completed. Dashboard freshness thresholds and scheduled live-smoke deadline settings now live in `frontend/app/lib/freshness-policy.json`; the UI imports the policy and tests guard release docs plus the weekly site-smoke workflow against silent drift.

tasks.title: Make degraded freshness states visually explicit on primary trust surfaces
tasks.notes: Completed. Freshness severity now has shared UI helpers, the desktop map overlay exposes compact data/model freshness rows, and desktop/mobile detail plus diagnostics surfaces carry `data-freshness-state` styling for aging, stale, and unknown states.

tasks.title: Make post-deploy live browser smoke tolerant of short Cloudflare asset propagation windows
tasks.notes: Completed. `npm run ux:smoke:live` now wraps the strict Playwright smoke with bounded live-site retries, preserving one-shot local smoke behavior while reducing false negatives during Cloudflare Pages propagation.

tasks.title: Turn release go/no-go judgment into a required pull request artifact
tasks.notes: Completed. `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` now carries the release decision checklist fields and hard-blocker reminder, and tests guard the template plus operations linkage so go/no-go judgment is visible before merge.

tasks.title: Add a rollback drill that can be rehearsed from docs only
tasks.notes: Completed. `docs/ROLLBACK_DRILL.md` now separates dry-run rehearsal from real incident rollback, lists exact commands and validation evidence, and tests guard the links plus required smoke/verify/evidence fields.

tasks.title: Add a reusable Playwright UI/UX review gate with screenshot evidence
tasks.notes: Completed. `npm run ui:review` now exercises desktop/mobile dashboard states, selected-place trust ordering, filters, dark theme, info tabs, and `/verify`, saving screenshots plus a JSON report for release evidence.

tasks.title: Keep selected-place first-read order focused on sample date, official status, provenance, then model context
tasks.notes: Completed. Desktop and mobile selected-place surfaces now render sample date, official status, freshness/provenance, and verify/source before the model assessment, and the UI review script checks the explicit `data-trust-order` markers.
